analyst_view.overall: Leipzig (5th) host Augsburg (15th, one win in seven) three days after a Champions League game against Manchester City, and Martín Demichelis may rotate. Augsburg are without the suspended Juma Bah, plus Banks, Mounié, Breithaupt and Brackelmann (concussion). Leipzig have scored in eight straight games, while Augsburg have scored in ten straight and conceded in eight straight.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.7 goals. Augsburg's defence is weakened with Bah suspended and Brackelmann out, and both sides have long scoring runs. Possible Leipzig rotation after the City game holds us back from going higher than the model.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.4 corners. Leipzig should dominate territory at home, and nothing in the news changes that.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards. Augsburg's defensive changes could lead to some tactical fouls, but there is no specific discipline news. Daniel Schlager referees.

shots.text: The numbers say 32.3 shots. Leipzig's attack, led by the in-form Nusa, should create plenty, but a rotated XI after the Champions League is a small brake.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.9 shots on target. The news doesn't give a clear reason to move away from the model.
